value.a: THE INVOCATION IS THE SIGNAL, NOT A SEPARATE ACT: one live verb does walk + write-back with one embed — an opt-in signal would be skipped exactly when the honest datum is least flattering.

SIGNAL CONTENT IS THE ASK ITSELF; a repeat identical ask returns duplicate:true — the dedup is not lost frequency, it is frequency made readable at invoke time (v0, build-minimal; per-class counters grow against need).

UNDER-FLOOR HONESTY AS A TOOTH: a walk whose every node sits under the floor still returns the ranked nodes, flagged under_floor with the floor visible — because ranking was measured right (correct node first) at 0.5775 < 0.65 the day this was cast.

BERTHED STATE ATTACHES ONLY WHAT EXISTS: a provenance source that is a file on disk attaches parsed; a non-file source passes through untouched (orient's scars name sessions, not files); an unreadable file is named loudly — three honest shapes, no fabrication.
